Export gournal journal entries to Markdown or CSV, oldest first, optionally filtered by project, tags, and a date range. Returns the newest `limit` entries (default 200, max 2000). When more entries exist than `limit`, a second text block carries a notice.

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `format` | `"md" \| "csv"` | no | Default: `"md"`. |
| `project` | `string` | no | Filter by project name |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | Filter to entries containing all of these tags |
| `from` | `string` | no | Start date (inclusive): a local day or an ISO timestamp |
| `to` | `string` | no | End date (inclusive): a local day or an ISO timestamp |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Max entries (default 200, max 2000). The newest are kept. Default: `200`. |

## Output

This tool returns text content. It has no structured output.
